Scope: Static publisher-page, version, licensing, build-action and COM-inspection review of MiTeC OLE/COM Explorer and Project Maker; no payload executed, COM object activated, project built or signing key accessed

TermsPage.Observation: The current MiTeC support EULA states unregistered/trial freeware for non-commercial use and lists other license types. Product-page license options, owner-specific rights and redistribution remain distinct.

Products.Name: MiTeC OLE/COM Object Explorer
Products.PublishedBehavior: Publisher describes an OLE/COM object explorer with a type-library viewer but provides no version history or explicit release number on the page. Page lists Windows XP-11 and Server 2003-2025 as publisher claims only.
Products.LicenseObservation: The page calls it freeware for private, educational and non-commercial purposes. This does not establish local intended-use entitlement or redistribution.
Products.Acceptance: Use only a known inert synthetic COM registration/type-library fixture; first establish whether inspection activates an object or changes registration. Do not activate arbitrary registered COM servers or modify system/user COM registration.

Products.Name: MiTeC Project Maker
Products.DevelopmentVersion: 2.0.0 is labeled under development on the current page; its listed new features include WinARM64EC support, new UI and Git branch/repository detection.
Products.PublishedBehavior: Automates batch builds for Delphi projects, configurable compiler selection, arbitrary before/after actions, binary version-information patching, code signing with a specified certificate and third-party software protection. Supports Delphi versions listed from Borland Delphi 5-8 through Embarcadero Delphi XE-D13 where applicable.
Products.LicensePagePriceObservation: The page offers a 30-day trial and lists EUR 199 single, EUR 499 team and EUR 1599 site lifetime licenses on the review date. No local entitlement or redistribution decision is inferred.
Products.PreviousBoundedListing: PE installer with 18 listed entries; no inner payload extracted or action executed.
Products.Acceptance: Any later build test needs an isolated synthetic Delphi project and disposable output directory. Keep before/after actions constrained to that fixture, do not open real projects, and use only a disposable test code-signing certificate/key; never access a personal/production signing key. Verify exact outputs and cleanup.

ReviewFindings: The frozen archives and page snapshots match their pins. OLE/COM Explorer page does not give a release number; its pinned executable reports FileVersion 1.4.0.0 and ProductVersion 1.0.0.0.

The previous inventory's Project Maker PageVersion value of 2.0.0 conflates a development label with the released version. The current official page calls 2.0.0 under development and lists 1.9.0 as the released version; the pinned installer outer PE also reports 1.9.0. Installed payload version remains unverified.

Project Maker's user-defined pre/post actions, compiler calls, version patching, signing and protection can affect selected project/output files and external tools. The product page does not establish the installer payload's setup/removal behavior or exact action isolation.

MigrationDisposition.Resolved: OLE/COM executable version is distinguished from the unversioned product page; Project Maker 1.9.0 release is distinguished from 2.0.0 development, and build/signing effects are recorded.
MigrationDisposition.Partial: COM activation/registration effects, exact installer actions, Project Maker dependencies and output containment, local license entitlement, UI and installed behavior remain unverified.
Deferred: Owner-specific use and distribution review for both products
No arbitrary COM activation or registry changes; later use only an inert synthetic object/type library
No real Delphi projects or production signing keys; later build tests require isolated synthetic source/output and disposable signing keys
Installer actions and exact activation/removal recovery through a future approved guest workflow
MigrationDisposition.EstimateReason: The release/development discrepancy and behavioral gates are clarified, but no complete legacy outcome or safe runtime acceptance is closed; no estimate deduction is justified.
